decided_by: docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment (2026-10-03): E1, weed-box base v3 (pre-registered), revision 3 (before any build): revision 2 (v1 plus zenodo_15808623 as an intake source capped as a family) with zenodo_15808623's frames grouped by video (intake group_regex), because frames of one video in both test v1 and arm B would make test v1 dependent on arm B, and with every row of an increment the stream has in flight kept out of test v1 as a pool row is; human:harry567566@gmail.com under the 2026-09-30 grant
why: Every weed box of every admitted source becomes INC class 12 (OtherPlant), so the E1 models are one-class weed detectors that every inc2 check, the pinned driver and the locked scorer accept; crop and non-plant boxes are dropped (background); an image without a weed box after the rules is not admitted. The include list is an allow-list: a registry slug that is not listed here is never read (excluded, 'not listed').

rules.box_side: geometric mean: sqrt(w x h) of the box in pixels after the image's long side is scaled to 640 (COCO's area convention: a box is small when its area is below side^2); one definition for every rule below

source.why: A source is admitted only if its weed boxes, as delivered, meet all four: median side >= 32 px at 640, at most 25 % of boxes under 16 px, at most 10 % of boxes covering more than 80 % of their image, median boxes per image (images with a weed box) at most 25. Base_v2 is exempt (A is base_v2 whole).

box.why: A weed box under 8 px at 640 is removed and its rectangle filled with the image's mean colour (inc2.mask.masked_array: pixel_rect rounding, rounded mean RGB, kept boxes' pixels never filled). Polygon lines become their bounding box.

image.why: An image is dropped if a weed box covers more than 90 % of it, if its shorter side is under 320 px, if the masked area exceeds 50 %, or if no weed box remains. Base_v2 rows are exempt from every image and box rule.

dedupe.why: Exact copies (same original bytes) are one image. Near copies: dHash within 3 bits under one of the 8 flips and rotations AND at least 80 % of the larger box set matched one-to-one at IoU >= 0.8 after that transform; or an identical label layout (coordinates rounded to 0.01, at least 3 boxes) whose dHashes lie within 10 bits under one of the 8 variants (an identical layout on unrelated photos is not a copy). Kept: the lowest provider tier, then the higher resolution, then the slug, then the key; base_v2 rows are always kept. Never 4-6 bits inside training.

holdout.why: Main-test holdout v1: from every included external source ~15 % of its kept rows (min 30, max 400 images), in whole capture groups, never trained. A capture group joins images within 6 dHash bits under the 8 variants (both directions), near and layout copies, the same Roboflow export stem across the source (across the family for a family), the intake capture group and a source's file-name session (group_regex: a registry source's on its file names, an intake source's on its rows' original file names). It is computed before the stream's quarantine is applied, so test v1 is the same whichever sources are quarantined (a quarantined source's held rows stay in test v1; its other rows stay out of arm B). Groups are named and ordered by their own content: per source, by stable_int(seed_text/source/sha256 of the group's sorted member sha256s), a group holding a row of an earlier build's test list first. A group is taken only while every source with rows in it stays at or under 400 held images, and each source's own count includes its rows held in other sources' groups. A group touching base_v2, any row of the stream's pools (an image a current model trained on) or any row of an increment the stream has in flight (cut, suspect, or any status that has not released its rows: a pool may still take it; revision 3), or larger than 400 images, is never held out. Every row an earlier build's test list holds (splits/*/test_v1/*.jsonl: the same bytes or key, a shared capture relation, or within 6 dHash bits under the 8 variants) never trains.

dock.why: The Rumex obtusifolius ('0 ridderzuring' / 'grass weeds') photo set uploaded under 16 slugs: at most 35 % of base v3's images, D <= floor(0.35 / 0.65 x non-dock images), applied after the holdout by seeded whole capture groups; its Roboflow export stems are shared across the 16 slugs.

siu.why: One greenhouse, one set of potted plants, filmed: at most 35 % of base v3's images, as the dock family (S <= floor(0.35 / 0.65 x non-SIU images), applied after the holdout by seeded whole capture groups, a video's frames being one group through the source's group_regex, revision 3). Without it the 40,000 frames would be about 63 % of arm B, and arm B would mostly measure one greenhouse; with it, arm B is about 35K images (23K as is plus about 12K SIU). Decided before any build, from counts only.

walltime.why: A base run of cold_budget trains 1.2M image-epochs; its rate is the slower of the GPU (m640 measured: b_v2_m640 base__s0 trained 6,811 x 100 image-epochs in 8,613.8 s, 12.65 ms, cache ram; 0.27 h of fixed overhead in its 2 h 39 min wall) and the loader that feeds it (measured by the build on a seeded 3,200-row sample of arm B through Ultralytics' own training dataset and DataLoader, 5 workers, no cache). A projected run over 0.8 x the 8 h cold limit (D26's line) cannot run: the build then writes splits v3 with status over_walltime, which no E1 arm builds on, and ends with a refusal (a person's card).

base_v2.why: Splits v2's base_v2 (LOCK v2, by sha256): every box becomes class 12, nothing else changes; it is arm A whole and inside arm B, byte for byte.

evaluation_groups.why: The evaluation groups (test v1's groups and the OOD-dev groups) are excluded by name; their images are also a guard: every candidate row within 6 dHash bits (GuardV2's never-train radius) under the 8 variants, in both directions, of any of their images is dropped (near_eval_group), never in arm B and never in test v1. Their hashes: the v1 Step 1 pool's stored 8-variant hashes, else hashed by the build from the registry's local_path. summary.json reports the rows within 3 and within 6 bits per group and source; base_v2's rows are counted, never dropped.
